baits.name: Garden Worm
baits.flavor: Dug fresh from behind the Brewery, much to the worm's ongoing surprise. The classic for a reason.

baits.name: Baker's Doughball
baits.flavor: Day-old bread rolled with a little honey. Pond fish adore it; the baker pretends not to know where his scraps go.

baits.name: Meadow Cricket
baits.flavor: Chirps right up until the cast, then goes professionally quiet. River fish consider it fine dining.

baits.name: Flash Minnow
baits.flavor: A little silver show-off that catches the light on purpose. Bigger fish take it personally.

baits.name: Brine Shrimp
baits.flavor: Salted, curled, and irresistible to anything with gills and ambition. Sold by the scoop at the harbor stall.

baits.name: Tin Spinner
baits.flavor: Hammered from an old kettle by the isle's tinker. It wobbles like injured prey and outlasts every worm you've ever loved.

baits.name: Inkwell Squid
baits.flavor: Leaves a dramatic little plume on the way down. Deep-sea hunters follow the ink like gossip.

baits.name: Royal Nightcrawler
baits.flavor: A worm of considerable breeding, raised on compost from the manor gardens. It expects to be taken by something impressive, and usually is.

baits.name: Thunder Beetle
baits.flavor: Carries a static charge that makes the water tingle for yards around. Fish arrive angry, which is convenient.

baits.name: Gilded Krill
baits.flavor: Each one is hand-brushed with edible gold leaf by a merchant who refuses to explain why it works. It works.

baits.name: Glowgrub
baits.flavor: Raised in the Bait Farm's mushroom beds until it glows a gentle cave-green. Fat, luminous, and deeply persuasive in dark water.

baits.name: Prism Minnow
baits.flavor: Bred in the Bait Farm's rainbow tanks; its scales split sunlight into colors that don't have names yet. Rare fish cross entire biomes to investigate.

baits.name: Moonlit Mayfly
baits.flavor: Hatches only under a full moon in the Bait Farm's night garden and lives for one perfect cast. Make it count.

baits.name: Wisp in a Jar
baits.flavor: The Bait Farm's crowning oddity: a coaxed sliver of marsh-light that sings underwater. Legends rise to hear the end of the song.
